title: Iran conflict lifts mortgage rates, but housing demand stays positive
summary: Pending sales rose to 63,971 versus 61,143 in 2025, inventory ended at 844,011, and price cuts were 39.57% versus 41%.

title: New housing law targets affordability — what it means for homebuyers and sellers
summary: While the legislation is aimed at least partly at addressing affordability, experts say the benefits of the measure will take time to show up in the market.
